next.reason: 1985: after a contained program's end program header 'the next statement must either be an Identification Division header or another end program header which terminates the containing program'. §2023:10.6.1 keeps the same structure for a program-definition ('[ procedure-division [ program-definition ] … ]' followed by the optional end marker), so what follows a contained program is another program-definition or the container's end marker. Looser: the program-definition's '[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ]' header is optional in 2023, so the next statement may be a PROGRAM-ID paragraph. SR-10.7.3-3 carries 1985 SR3 (end-marker order), not this rule. Every conforming 1985 program means the same.
